pages.{name} は、英語・中国語・韓国語のニュースを原文のまま集めて、日本語訳と並: {name} collects news in English, Chinese and Korean in the original and sets it beside a translation into your language. Headlines show the translation large, with the original in small type beneath. Articles open as paragraph-by-paragraph parallel text; choose “Translation only” to read just the translation. Tap a word you don't know to see what it means.

pages.「別のニュース」を押した記事は、このグループから外れ、以後この記事どうしが同じグ: An article marked “Different story” leaves this group, and these articles will not be grouped together again (you can undo this all at once on the status page).
pages.「最初に報じた」は複数の媒体が報じたニュースのうち、その媒体の記事がいちばん早か: “First to report” counts the stories reported by more than one outlet in which this outlet's article came first (out of those it reported). “Median delay” is the time from the first report to this outlet's first article. “Conflicting figures” counts the figure conflicts shown on the home page (well-matched groups only) it was part of. “How it was reported” is judged from the article's opening (the dateline), “Signs of own reporting” from phrases such as “told the BBC” or “接受中央社訪問”, and “Cites other outlets” counts the articles that quote other news organisations. While outlets started being collected at different times, delays can look large.
